---
title: "NIMBioS affiliates grants"
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

# Install once if needed:
# install.packages(c("httr2", "dplyr", "purrr", "stringr", "DT"))

library(httr2)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)
library(DT)

# This path is relative to the directory containing this .qmd file.
affiliates <- read.csv("../NIMBioS_affiliates.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Prefer a clearly labelled name column; otherwise use the first character column.
name_column <- names(affiliates)[str_detect(names(affiliates), regex("name", ignore_case = TRUE))][1]
if (is.na(name_column) || length(name_column) == 0) {
  name_column <- names(affiliates)[which(vapply(affiliates, is.character, logical(1)))[1]]
}
if (is.na(name_column) || length(name_column) == 0) {
  stop("Could not identify a faculty-name column in ../NIMBioS_affiliates.csv.")
}

faculty <- affiliates |>
  transmute(faculty = str_squish(as.character(.data[[name_column]]))) |>
  filter(!is.na(faculty), faculty != "") |>
  distinct()
  
faculty <- rbind(faculty, data.frame(faculty=c("Nina Fefferman", "Suzanne Lenhart", "Sergey Gavrilets", "Allison Buchan"))) # include past leaders

nsf_endpoint <- "https://api.nsf.gov/services/v1/awards.json"
utk_awardee <- "University of Tennessee Knoxville"

get_awards <- function(faculty_name, role) {
  role_parameter <- if (role == "PI") "pdPIName" else "coPDPI"
  offset <- 0
  out <- list()

  repeat {
    query <- list(
      awardeeName = utk_awardee,
      ActiveAwards = "true",
	  ExpiredAwards = "true",
      rpp = "25",
      offset = as.character(offset),
      sortKey = "startDate"
    )
    query[[role_parameter]] <- faculty_name

    response <- request(nsf_endpoint) |>
      req_url_query(!!!query) |>
      req_perform()
    payload <- resp_body_json(response, simplifyVector = FALSE)$response

    if (!is.null(payload$serviceNotification)) {
      stop(payload$serviceNotification[[1]]$notificationMessage)
    }

    batch <- payload$award %||% list()
    if (!is.list(batch)) batch <- list(batch)
    if (length(batch) == 0) break

    out <- c(out, batch)
    offset <- offset + length(batch)
    total <- as.integer(payload$metadata$totalCount %||% 0)
    if (offset >= total) break
  }

  map_dfr(out, function(x) {
    tibble(
      faculty = faculty_name,
      role = role,
      award_id = x$id %||% NA_character_,
      title = x$title %||% NA_character_,
      awardee = x$awardeeName %||% NA_character_,
      start_date = x$startDate %||% NA_character_,
      expiration_date = x$expDate %||% NA_character_,
      estimated_total = as.numeric(x$estimatedTotalAmt %||% NA_character_),
      funds_obligated = as.numeric(x$fundsObligatedAmt %||% NA_character_)
    )
  })
}

# httr2's null-coalescing helper is internal; define a local equivalent.
`%||%` <- function(x, y) if (is.null(x)) y else x

safe_get_awards <- purrr::safely(get_awards, otherwise = tibble())

results_and_errors <- tidyr::crossing(faculty, role = c("PI", "Co-PI")) |>
  mutate(query = map2(faculty, role, safe_get_awards))

search_errors <- results_and_errors |>
  transmute(faculty, role, error = map_chr(query, ~ if (is.null(.x$error)) "" else conditionMessage(.x$error))) |>
  filter(error != "")

results <- results_and_errors |>
  transmute(data = map(query, "result")) |>
  tidyr::unnest(data) |>
  distinct(faculty, role, award_id, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  arrange(desc(start_date), faculty)
  
results <- results[grepl("Tennessee", results$awardee),]

results <- results[!duplicated(results$award_id),]

results$start_date <- as.Date(results$start_date, format = "%m/%d/%Y")
results$expiration_date <- as.Date(results$expiration_date, format = "%m/%d/%Y")

results <- arrange(results, desc(start_date))
results$Current <- "Y"
results$Current[which(results$expiration_date<Sys.Date())] <- "N"
results <- results[results$start_date >= as.Date("09/01/2008", format = "%m/%d/%Y"),]

results_current <- subset(results, results$Current=="Y")

money <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "—", paste0("$", format(round(x), big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE)))
```

## Summary

This is an underestimate: it includes only NSF grants that have gone to current NIMBioS affiliates and/or past NIMBioS leaders with the University of Tennessee, Knoxville, as the awardee.

```{r}
#| results: asis

unique_awards <- n_distinct(results_current$award_id)
match_count <- nrow(results_current)
award_current <- results_current |>
  distinct(award_id, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  summarise(total = sum(estimated_total, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  pull(total)
  
award_total <- results |>
  distinct(award_id, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  summarise(total = sum(estimated_total, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  pull(total)

cat(sprintf(
  "**%s unique active award%s** · **%s faculty-role match%s** · **%s estimated total across active awards** · **%s estimated total across NIMBioS awards**",
  format(unique_awards, big.mark = ","), ifelse(unique_awards == 1, "", "s"),
  format(match_count, big.mark = ","), ifelse(match_count == 1, "", "es"),
  money(award_current), money(award_total)
))
```

## Awards

```{r}
#| label: awards-table

if (nrow(results) == 0) {
  cat("No active PI or co-PI matches were returned for the loaded faculty list.")
} else {
  display_results <- results |>
    mutate(
      `Title` = sprintf(
        '<a href="https://www.nsf.gov/awardsearch/showAward?AWD_ID=%s" target="_blank" rel="noopener">%s</a>',
        award_id, title
      ),
      `Estimated total` = money(estimated_total),
      `Funds obligated` = money(funds_obligated)
    ) |>
    select(
      Faculty = faculty, `Estimated total`, Role = role, `Title`,
      Awardee = awardee, `Start date` = start_date, `Expiration date` = expiration_date
    )

	
  datatable(
    display_results,
    escape = FALSE,
	style = "bootstrap",
    rownames = FALSE,
    filter = "top",
    extensions = "Buttons",
    options = list(
      pageLength = 100,
      scrollX = TRUE,
      dom = "Bfrtip",
      buttons = c("copy", "csv", "excel")
    )
  )
}
```

```{r}
#| label: api-errors
#| results: asis

if (nrow(search_errors) > 0) {
  cat("## NSF API query errors\n\n")
  knitr::kable(search_errors)
}
```
